summary: Narrow dense street; houses 4-15 m from kerb, resident-parked.
reasons: Narrow lane, cars park both sides

best_section.where: Telarah Street west kerb, towards the southern end

drivers.seclusion: Houses 13 m, 15 m and 18 m from the kerb on the same side; more across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with parked cars on both sides; little room to pull clear.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street, but the van would sit among houses.

flags: Steep: 7% mean, 15% max over the stretch
sun_shade: Garden trees give patchy shade, mostly from the west.
